hook.en: I don't know. We're going to find out.

objective: Season finale. The fifth and final fragment completes the cipher: YOU ARE NOT LOST. YOU ARE BUILDING THE MAP. The Traveler looks back across every act — the many lives, the failures, the platform, the agents, the tenants, the machines, the new curiosities — and understands they were never a detour. Moon reveals many paths still unexplored. The season ends deliberately open: the map is still being drawn.

captions.es: No estabas perdido. Estabas construyendo el mapa.
captions.en: You were never lost. You were building the map.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: The Traveler and NØVA standing before the full Moon map, full cipher text glowing: YOU ARE NOT LOST. YOU ARE BUILDING THE MAP. — many portals around them still dim/unexplored

notes: Season 1 finale — parallel mystery thread payoff, not a numbered Act — see ../../canon/SYMBOLS.md and ../../canon/ORIGIN-SAGA.md.

Theme: reframing the entire season — dispersion (Act I) was never a detour, it was the map being built. Central conflict from Act I ('¿Estoy construyendo algo real, o simplemente saltando de idea en idea?') is answered, not erased.

Emotional conflict resolved (not eliminated): purpose found in retrospect, not as a fixed destination ahead. Faith present as quiet hope, not certainty — no deity appears on-screen; The Traveler looks at the sky, finds no magic answer, and goes back to work.
Closing dialogue (final scene): NØVA — "¿Y ahora para dónde?" The Traveler, looking at all the still-dark portals — "No tengo idea." NØVA smiles — "Perfecto." Cut to black.
Closing card: "OPSLY — THE PARALLEL PATH. The map is still being drawn."

Ending is deliberately open by design — this is real-time storytelling about an unfinished journey, not a closed arc with a guaranteed outcome. Do not add a version of this ending that implies a specific future product/result as already achieved.
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 13.
